name: build-brief
description: On explicit invocation, compile software intent into an approval-bound developer execution contract and faithful plain-language explanation.

interface.shortDescription: Approve the full execution contract before coding.
interface.longDescription: When explicitly invoked, Build Brief translates a software request and repository context into the smallest complete developer execution contract, including implementation, phases, steps, tasks, plan, and execution order. It then explains the same contract plainly and waits for explicit approval. After approval it implements only the staged contract; material changes require a revised contract and new approval. Without invocation it adds no session context and blocks nothing.
defaultPrompt: Create a complete developer execution contract for this request, explain it plainly, and wait for approval before implementation.
Design and implement this change with Build Brief, but show the full execution contract and wait for approval before editing.
Create a handoff-ready execution contract and faithful plain-language explanation for this request without implementing it.
